## About
MN.KP is the personal platform of MOHAMMED NIHAD KP — a freelancer, businessman and AI-first developer based in Calicut, Kerala, India. He builds apps, websites and digital solutions using AI-driven development workflows, alongside photography, videography and marketing services. The site hosts a practical blog on AI tools and business growth, an honestly-curated affiliate store (Amazon Associates & Flipkart partner), and a services hub with a direct inquiry form.
